list.question: How do I register for the Golden Falcon Awards?
list.answer: Register online through our Tickets page. Once confirmed, you'll receive your invitation details and event access via email within 48 hours.

list.question: What is the dress code for the evening?
list.answer: Black-tie or formal evening attire is required. The organisers reserve the right to review attire at the entrance to maintain the event's standard of elegance.

list.question: Where is the event held?
list.answer: The Golden Falcon Awards 2026 will take place at the Conrad Hotel, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE. Valet parking and complimentary transfers are available for VIP guests.

list.question: Can I transfer my ticket to a colleague?
list.answer: Yes. Tickets may be transferred by updating the attendee information in your account at least 7 days prior to the event. Please contact support@gtcfx.com for assistance.

sections.title: Registration & Entry
sections.body: All attendees must register online and present a valid confirmation email along with government-issued photo identification at the entrance. Event access details and updates will be sent to the email address provided during registration. For assistance, contact support@gtcfx.com.

sections.title: Dress Code
sections.body: Black-tie or formal evening attire is required for all guests. The organisers reserve the right to review attire at the entrance to uphold the event's standard of elegance. Smart casual attire will not be permitted.

sections.title: Ticket Transfers
sections.body: Tickets may be transferred to another attendee by updating the attendee information in your account at least 7 days prior to the event date. Transfer requests submitted after this deadline will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

sections.title: Privacy Policy
sections.body: Personal information collected during registration is used exclusively for event administration, guest communication, and safety purposes. All data is processed and stored in accordance with applicable data protection regulations, including the UAE Federal Data Protection Law.

sections.title: Media & Recording Consent
sections.body: Professional photography and video recording will take place throughout the event for editorial, promotional, and archival purposes. By attending, guests consent to the potential use of their likeness in such materials published by GTCFX and its media partners.

sections.title: Cancellations & Refunds
sections.body: Cancellation and refund requests are evaluated on a case-by-case basis. Please contact the events team at support@gtcfx.com or call +971 800 667788 as early as possible. Refunds requested fewer than 14 days before the event may be subject to administrative fees.
